epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduction in mean time to complete analysis (MTTCA)
requirements: R1: Goal: Increase the speed of epidemiological analysis. Question 1: How long does an analyst take from starting a session to exporting the final report? Question 2: Which stage takes the most time?
R2: Measure the total duration it takes an epidemiologist to complete an analysis workflow.
R3: Emit a telemetry event with the analysis speed metric to the observability platform, noting that standard end-user chains are outside the scope of this measurement capability.

slices.title: Instrument analysis speed metric
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for this epic, I want to calculate the analysis duration answering how long analysts take to complete a session, so that the analysis speed metric is recorded and emitted.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an active epidemiological analysis session,
When the user finalizes the dossier,
Then the backend must calculate the total duration.
Given the calculated duration,
When the event is processed,
Then the metric is emitted to the observability platform.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of completed analyses emit a duration metric

slices.title: Verify analysis speed metric telemetry flow
slices.jtbd: When implementing verification for this epic, I want to ensure the duration telemetry is accurately calculated and emitted, so that the measurement data is reliable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the telemetry instrumentation,
When the end-to-end analysis workflow is simulated,
Then the tests must verify the correct calculation of duration.
Given the emitted event,
When it reaches the observability platform,
Then the payload matches the expected schema and includes the correct duration value.
